about: Cybersecurity-focused developer building toward Bug Bounty and Web Application Security. I build software projects, explore security concepts, and document practical work with an emphasis on clear, reproducible results.
technical_foundations: SQL Server — KDB Book Manager and Simple User Admin Panel

projects.name: NightHawk
projects.description: A Bash utility for Kali Linux that discovers package mirrors, measures response times, backs up APT sources, and updates the configuration after confirmation.

projects.name: KDB Book Manager
projects.description: An ASP.NET WebForms application for managing book records with SQL Server, including create, edit, delete, and view operations.

projects.name: Simple User Admin Panel
projects.description: A SQL Server-backed user-management application with add, edit, delete, and list workflows.

projects.name: MultiFunc
projects.description: An Android utility application with SMS, BMI and age calculations, account flows, tutorials, calculator, discount calculation, and password generation.

projects.name: Snake Game
projects.description: A browser-based neon Snake game with keyboard controls and a Persian right-to-left interface.
